fault: any failure after the lease is taken and before it is released: an injected error on the next D1 statement (a 500, the lease stays held), a crash after the lease's run, or an ambiguous outcome on it
description: A webhook applies events under a per-subscription D1 lease and answers 503 while it is held. The lease outlives the caller's resend window, so a failure that leaves it held makes every resend fail and the event is lost.
